687163.title: Project Hail Mary

1294395.title: Second Nature: Gender and Sexuality in the Animal World
1294395.overview: Did you know that clownfish change sex from male to female? (So if Nemo’s mom had died in real life, his dad could have become his mom!) Did you know that albatross, penguins and swans parent in same sex pairs? Or that bonobos, who are just as closely related to us as chimps, are matriarchal and have same-sex sex every day?!  Narrated by Elliot Page, Second Nature follows trailblazing Evolutionary Biologist Dr. Joan Roughgarden as she meets groundbreaking scientists exploring the 1500+ animal species who engage in same-sex sexual behavior and parenting, change sex, form matriarchies, and more,  debunking myths that females are “inferior” and that being queer is “unnatural.”  SECOND NATURE — everything you didn’t learn in high school biology.

Surrounded by women struggling to shield their families, she carries a fractured relationship to motherhood, shaped by loss and survival rather than care. When a new, more organized criminal force begins to restructure the underground economy, independent lives like hers grow increasingly disposable, and Boomah is pushed to confront what it means to survive in a world where violence is labor, children inherit the streets, and motherhood is both a wound and a responsibility.

1697595.overview: The Alone Boy is an upcoming drama-action film directed by Resad Ajim, developed as an emotionally driven cinematic project exploring themes of loneliness, ambition, survival, and personal transformation.  The movie is expected to combine emotional storytelling with intense character development, focusing on the struggles of a young individual navigating isolation and conflict in a changing world.  The film centers around a boy whose life is shaped by emotional hardship, betrayal, and the pressure of survival. As the story progresses, the central character faces challenges involving friendship, trust, family struggles, and the pursuit of identity. The narrative is designed to portray the emotional journey of a person attempting to rise above difficult circumstances while confronting inner fears and external obstacles.

1698491.title: Ang Buhay
1698491.overview: Jo, an aspiring musician, on the brink of giving up is finally given an opportunity in the music industry.  Tasked to write a song with the theme 'Ang Buhay...', she scans her life to find the right inspiration.

1699835.title: Useless
1699835.overview: A man starts using an AI therapist and soon faces humiliating consequences

1701371.title: Un jeu dangereux
1701371.overview: In a summer villa, a couple married for twenty years invites an enigmatic young woman. Amidst desire, jealousy, and unspoken words, a dangerous game unfolds where each plays their part. Their children, watching from afar, anxiously observe: who is playing with whom? Is their mother in danger?

1701435.title: dashed in here, seeing you green
1701435.overview: Disappearing acts, or a longing for green. Based on an extract from Virginia Woolf's The Waves.  Part of the "vaster than empires and more slow" cycle, filmic meditations on the fear, fragility, and stupor encountered in mineral, plant, and animal (including the filmmaker) interactions.

1701499.title: Uposhongshar
1701499.overview: A devoted husband refuses to lose hope for his wife in a coma, and despite his family's objections and concerns about their daughter's future, he remains determined to do everything possible for her recovery.
1701499.trailerName: EId Natok - Uposhongshar (উপসংসার) | Polash | Safa Kabir | Ashikur | BiggB | New Bangla Natok 2026

1701947.title: Лучшее лето в жизни
1701947.overview: Brother and sister, teenagers Savva and Aglaya, live in the city and do what they like most. Savva is a fan of computer games and an eternal fidget. Aglaya is a young genius of science who dreams of making an important discovery. Each has plans for the summer holidays: Savva is going to a games festival, and Aglaya is working on a project at a science camp. But one day, their plans fall apart. Since the guys are always teasing each other, arguing about everything and can't agree on anything, one day a disaster occurs, as a result of which their apartment is simultaneously flooded with water and engulfed in fire. As punishment, the parents send the children to the village to their grandparents. For Savva and Aglaya, this is a nightmare: they are used to food delivery, entertainment, games and the Internet, and in the village they have to get up early, work in the garden, feed for slaughter, go to the bathhouse and a bunch of other village "delights".

1702459.title: Seafarers
1702459.overview: Amorous sailors bite off more than they can chew when they stop into a seaside pub.

1703675.title: Ramani Kalyanam

1703675.trailerName: Ramani Kalyanam Trailer | Surya Vashistta | Deepshikha Chandran | Premieres June 12 | ETVWIN

1705083.title: The Blistering Blundering West

1706043.title: Ghost Buzzer: Antar Aku Pulang
1706043.overview: Four mystery-loving friends investigate a haunted basement and encounter the spirit of Maria, who begs for help returning home. Their mission leads them on an adventure filled with terror, puzzles, and friendship as they help the spirits find peace.
1706043.trailerName: Ghost Buzzer - Antar Aku Pulang - CINEMA 21 Trailer

1709115.title: Abnormal business
1709115.overview: When a group of five teenagers, working for a paranormal investigating company, enter the haunted home of a random Dutch man, they realize the horrors of what they are about to face.

1710011.title: The NOAH Flood
1710011.overview: The Noah Flood investigates the biblical story of Noah through dramatic reenactments, geological evidence, and historical analysis. From massive rock formations to fossil mysteries, the film asks a bold question, could the global flood described in Genesis be real history written in the earth itself?

1710203.title: Tony Hinchcliffe: Man of the People
1710203.overview: Tony Hinchcliffe takes center stage to prove no topic is too taboo and nothing is off-limits — not even the audience — in this razor-sharp special.
1710203.trailerName: Tony Hinchcliffe: Man of the People | Sneak Peek | Netflix

1710971.title: Kiralık Koca: Aşk mı, Oyun mu?
1710971.overview: To escape her father's pressure to get married, Melike tells a lie and makes a deal with Ali, a charming con man, for a two-month fake marriage in exchange for money. With women constantly chasing Ali, items mysteriously disappearing from the house, and an over-the-top fake mother-in-law, things quickly spiral out of control for Melike. Despite the ongoing chaos and her constant bickering with Ali, she must keep up the charade to avoid getting caught by her father and being forced to marry a complete stranger.
1710971.trailerName: Kiralık Koca: Aşk Mı, Oyun Mu? TV'de İlk Kez 8 Haziran Pazartesi NOW'da!

1711419.title: Boyuna
1711419.overview: Marseille, 2135. Following the disappearance of most terrestrial ecosystems, the Boyuna corporation offers survivors an escape into a world where they can relive dreams of the past alongside extinct animals.

1711611.title: Squatch
1711611.overview: After discovering a Sasquatch in the Smoky Mountains, park rangers Robert and Sam find themselves in over their heads when tech giant Alphazon plans to destroy its habitat. With no real authority and even less of a plan, they decide to relocate the creature themselves, driving it cross-country to the Pacific Northwest. Watch as Robert and Sam try to do one small, wildly impractical good thing.

1711867.title: DISTANCE
1711867.overview: A chronically online, awkward young man has an unhealthy addiction of watching a small content creator every single day, disregarding vital tasks and isolating himself, but when his favorite icon misses a video upload one day, he finds himself in a sequence of psychologically conflicting events.
1711867.trailerName: DISTANCE (2026) – Official Trailer | Short Film by Luke Tesei

1714619.title: Choked
1714619.overview: Shakona doesn't always want to be treated so nicely... sometimes she wants to feel like the world does: chaotic. Yet she can't get her devoted and loving boyfriend Eddie to meet her needs, so she goes to where all good decisions are made: a hookup app. Just as it seems like Shakona is finally letting go, she has the chance to take power into her own hands.

1714747.title: Blood and Filth
1714747.overview: A wild Israeli horror-comedy, with neither boundaries nor responsibility, combining  a dysfunctional family, demons, murders, a dark legend and a lot of chaos.

1716987.title: The Story Of Dr Dolittle
1716987.overview: Jeanette Dolittle ( Pink Pinkett Jones)  is a young teenager who discovers that she has inherited the extraordinary ability to communicate with animals. As she learns to understand the voices of pets, farm animals, and wildlife, she forms a special bond with a scruffy terrier wearing a pink collar and heart-shaped tag. Together, Jeanette and her animal friends embark on their first adventure, learning that helping animals can change lives. This film serves as the origin story of Jeanette's journey.

1717755.title: Sol Summer
1717755.overview: A woman, healing from her family's wounds, recounts her past to a Deity before the world's coming judgment.

1717883.title: Oreste
1717883.overview: Oreste is caught up in an obsessive search for a girl who perfectly matches his bizarre ideals, as he wanders through a sweltering summer in Rome.

1719099.title: DUMPED
1719099.overview: As Glenn sits by himself in a park after having his relationship come to an end, his mate Chris appears and takes him on a day out to help get his mind off the whole ordeal.

1720187.title: Faithless
1720187.overview: After a personal loss, Savannah’s grief begins to distort her perception of reality. As she tries to understand what she is experiencing, her sense of faith, memory, and truth begins to break down.

1721659.title: Something Seems Off
1721659.overview: A group of three teenage boys decide to go ghost hunting in their friends backyard, and when things go wrong there is nobody they can trust.

1722939.title: somniaque
cast: Franny Pédron -- de Firmas de Périès

1723579.title: Dongamohan
1723579.overview: Mohan is a thief attempting to steal from a wealthy household. Will he get caught or get away?

1724795.title: Hidden Trees

1724923.title: Skerry & May
1724923.overview: In the near future, May returns to a remote Scottish island for one last conversation with her lost partner, in a world drifting between memory and simulation, laying bare both grief and the limits of technology.

1727099.title: Five Orphans

1729339.title: Under The Rug

1729723.overview: A defective lamp reveals a heartbreaking truth about what Homer believes is reality, and an AI-powered tablet befriends and controls Maggie. The Simpsons struggle to find the light through two dark tales of the curious and bizarre.

1730043.title: Dead Soldier II
1730043.overview: Reese Cadler has moved to a country-side town after being attacked by The Soldier, a gas mask wearing killer  whom, unfathomably so, has managed to survived multiple gunshot wounds and evade police. One year later, he’s come back, and the war is not yet over.

1732475.title: Shadow Wounds
1732475.overview: After waking alone in a dark forest with no memory of how she got there, a young woman follows a mysterious lantern while being haunted by whispers that seem to know her deepest fears. As reality and nightmare begin to merge, she must confront the truth hidden within the shadows before it consumes her completely.

1733243.title: Sight & Sound Presents: JOSHUA—Live!
1733243.overview: Journey alongside the people of Israel as they navigate their new-found freedom in an unforgiving wilderness. When Joshua is called to replace Moses as their faithful leader, tensions mount in the midst of dwindling supplies and approaching armies. With one last fortified city standing between the Israelites and the Promised Land, unexpected help emerges from behind enemy lines and Joshua's trust in God's plan is put to the ultimate test.  Filmed in front of a live audience, this special event invites you to experience one of the most redemptive stories of the Bible come to life like never before!
1733243.trailerName: JOSHUA | Premiering 2026 in Lancaster, PA  | Sight & Sound Theatres®

1735867.title: Masc
1735867.overview: Robin, a young autistic man desperate to fit in, tries on different roles to understand what kind of man he's supposed to be.

1736187.title: Fuga
1736187.overview: Life has not been fulfilling to Mari.

1736507.title: Be Brave
1736507.overview: A documentary film that chronicles the extraordinary personal and entrepreneurial journey of Renzo Rosso, one of the most visionary figures in international fashion and communication. It tells this story by engaging with and utilizing artificial intelligence in a provocative and original way, placing the debate over the boundaries between human creativity and technology—and between the real and the artificial—at the heart of the film.

1739323.title: Lan Tha Rae
1739323.overview: Lan Tha Rae is a Myanmar horror-drama film produced by Aung Heik Film Production, directed by Academy Nyo Min Lwin, and is a heart-pounding and thrilling watch.

1739963.title: Ikenga: The Last Festival
1739963.overview: In the peaceful kingdom of Umuani, where honor, integrity, and sacred traditions guide the people, the use of dark spiritual forces is strongly condemned. But when a powerful man rises through forbidden powers and tests the resolve of the entire kingdom, the very foundation of their way of life is threatened. As the people suffer under his influence, the king and elders come under immense pressure to restore honor and preserve their sacred traditions.

1743163.title: The Cryonicist
1743163.overview: When her boyfriend is taken off life support by his family, a brilliant but obsessive college student risks everything to steal his body and DIY cryogenically freeze him.

1744763.title: The Tribe
1744763.overview: Silvano just wants to celebrate his wife Tere's birthday in peace, but his plan is ruined when his chaotic and contentious family shows up.

1748411.title: Wen er maar aan
1748411.overview: Actress M. is facing menopause, loses her long-running role in a crime series, has to deal with an apathetic teenage son, and her sex life is as dry as toast. She tries to reinvent herself, to prove to herself and to the world that she still has a future ahead of her.

1748987.title: Штраф

After fleeing the scene, he confronts the owner of the Volga he dented, a principled retiree, in his office. His futile attempts to evade justice deprive Artyom of everything, but they lead him to the most important thing: the ability to take responsibility for his actions.

1753467.title: Pramuka
1753467.overview: Panji and his Scout Patrol are preparing to attend a Penggalang Scout camping trip in the mountain forest. Unbeknownst to everyone, Budi, Panji's younger brother and a Cub Scout (Siaga) secretly sneaks aboard the group's truck, eager to experience the excitement of camping alongside his older brother. When Budi's presence is eventually discovered, he is allowed to stay and join Panji's group. What begins as an ordinary journey soon turns into a dangerous adventure when Panji and his patrol become separated from the main camp and find themselves lost deep within the forest. While searching for a way back, they stumble upon a terrifying secret: a hidden, abandoned warehouse where a criminal gang is holding kidnapped children captive. Caught in a life threatening situation, Panji and his friends must rely on their courage, ingenuity, teamwork, and the principles of the Scout Law (Dasa Dharma Pramuka) to survive, find help, and rescue the imprisoned children before it is too late.
1753467.trailerName: Nation's Character Education | Official Scout Trailer

1754363.title: PROXY
1754363.overview: Clyde and his Al girlfriend, Alora, excitedly try a new service that installs Alora into a real, live, human body. But the dream becomes a nightmare when they find out the body proxies are not sourced as advertised. Now Alora is faced with a devastating choice.

1754427.title: Settlement
1754427.overview: While enjoying nature, four friends encounter something definitely unnatural.

1756475.title: Jwala

1756475.trailerName: Jwala - Teaser | Baby Koba | Loga Varman | Aetherlight Studio

1757243.title: The Otherkind
1757243.overview: Chaos seeps into a sleepy mountain lake town, as something sinister comes to the surface.

1757371.title: Delusion
